item.title: FCC denies COVID-era waiver for Lifeline providers
item.description: The FCC said millions will be saved by a decision to reject a COVID-era waiver extension for Lifeline providers. #pressrelease

item.title: AT&T scuttles DEI policies as FCC readies review of spectrum deal
item.description: AT&T will end its DEI policies as the FCC prepares to review AT&T's acquisition of EchoStar spectrum. Tied in, the FCC today approved AT&T's $1 billion purchase of 700MHz and 3.45GHz spectrum from UScellular.

item.title: Charlie Vogt lends a hand to YTexas
item.description: Telecom vet Charlie Vogt is supporting YTexas, a Dallas-based executive network that connects business and civic leaders across Texas. #pressrelease

item.title: GCI and the Cordova Telecom Cooperative team on Alaskan subsea fiber project
item.description: GCI and the Cordova Telecom Cooperative have partnered to support the co-op's planned 560-mile subsea fiber project between Cordova and Juneau. The project will bring broadband to the unserved community of Pelican. #pressrelease

item.title: Comcast board OKs Versant spin-out
item.description: The Comcast board has approved a plan to separate Versant Media Group, an entity that will contain a portfolio of what will be former NBCUniversal cable networks. #pressrelease

item.title: Nvidia won't expect an AI-RAN challenge from Google
item.description: Google's tensor processing units (TPUs) have generated excitement as an alternative to Nvidia's GPUs, but a RAN role for them is unlikely.

item.title: Orange calls for crisis mindset on cybersecurity
item.description: With the impacts of cyberattacks reverberating across sectors and societies, Orange Cyberdefense argued for a mindset shift to unlock new ways of thinking during the launch of its annual Security Navigator report.

item.title: Eurobites: BT spots 'sovereign' opportunity
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: Vodacom gains control of Safaricom; Ericsson modernizes Swiss rail comms; Enea contains data breach.

item.title: DOCSIS spending dips again ahead of expected 2026 rebound
item.description: Cable operator spending on DOCSIS infrastructure dropped 31% in Q3 2025 as new products equipped with 'unified' silicon start to take hold. Spending in the category is expected to accelerate in 2026.

item.title: EU defers formal call for AI gigafactories to early 2026
item.description: Commissioner Henna Virkkunen says 'majority owners' of the large AI model training hubs 'should come from Europe' and rules out the presence of high-risk vendors.
